name: Senses LGD #8
description:
The soul is an open book if you look one in the eyes,
But gaining the trust of one for that time is harder to find,
Simply glancing is not looking,
And looking is not seeing,
Who loves you enough?
To allow you close enough,
To truly read their meaning?
